description: Append an event to a graded item's chain: sold, consigned, vaulted, withdrawn, shipped, received, flagged, retired, note. Events are append-only and, when public, appear on the buyer's tap page. `flagged` marks the item and needs a `note` saying why. `retired` ends the binding (the slab was re-holdered or destroyed) and needs a `note` saying why: the chip stops vouching for any label and the grader cert is freed to be bound to a new chip. A retired item accepts only `note` events.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601; not in the future, not before the item was sealed
